about.title: From a room, for the ones who dream awake
about.origin1: Maison Murano was born in a room. Not in an office, not in a big city: in the most honest place there is, where dreams turn into plans.
about.origin2: There, surrounded by sketches, ideas and sleepless nights, it all began. Born from a love for clothing and design, and the desire to create something with its own identity that carries emotion every time you wear it.
about.vision: Contemporary streetwear for those who believe dreams are built through action. For the ones who don't wait for the perfect moment: they create it.
about.design: Every piece has intention. We play with shape, texture, contrast and attitude. Each collection carries its own character, because true consistency lives in the vision, not in repetition.
about.mission: To inspire a generation of dreamers who work. To be more than clothing: a symbol of purpose, effort and authenticity.
about.close: If you're reading this, you're already part of it.
